caption: The drawing features a decorative composition with a horizontal band at the top and a repetitive floral pattern below. The upper band has a border of red and pink roses with green leaves and curving green stems, set against a light background and framed above and below by thin colored lines, one green and one ochre. The main field of the drawing, beneath the band, is divided into rectangular sections that are filled with a sparse arrangement of stylized flowers, each consisting of swirling black lines, red and yellow circular shapes, and spiral or curved green leaves and stems. The background throughout the lower section is a pale, off-white color with faint blue and gray cracks or lines that give a sense of aged, segmented plaster.
title: Hand Painted Wall (Detail)
